title: The Good Word Is Like a Good Tree

paragraphs.text: The messengers said, "We are men like you, but Allah favors whom He wills. Upon Allah we rely, and we will be patient with your harm." The disbelievers threatened to drive them out. Allah told the messengers He would destroy the wrongdoers and settle them in the land. Every stubborn tyrant failed. Hell is before him, with a drink he can hardly swallow.

The deeds of disbelievers are like ashes blown by a strong wind. Allah created the heavens and earth in truth. All will come before Him. The weak will ask the proud leaders for help, but they cannot help. Satan will say, "Allah's promise was true. I promised you and betrayed you. I only called you, and you answered. Do not blame me. Blame yourselves." Believers who did good will enter gardens with rivers. Their greeting there will be "Peace."

A good word is like a good tree. Its root is firm, and its branches reach the sky. It gives fruit at all times. A bad word is like a bad tree, pulled out of the ground. Allah keeps the believers firm in this life and the next.

hardWords.m: refusing to change, even when wrong
a cruel ruler who uses power wrongly
grey powder left after something burns
